semgrep-cloud-platform/scan.reason: Semgrep Cloud runs a server-side ruleset that no local hook reproduces, so a finding it raises cannot be cleared from a branch. The current finding, python.lang.security.audit.dangerous-subprocess-use-tainted-env-args, id 949800930, lands on the cmd argument of the subprocess.run call inside run_skill_knowledge in scripts/eval/eval-suite.py and is not exploitable: cmd is a list whose first element is sys.executable followed by a fixed script path, subprocess.run defaults to shell=False, and no shell parses the argv, so the rule's suggested shlex.quote would corrupt the value rather than protect it. Clearing the check needs a triage in the semgrep.dev org UI, which neither CI nor a branch can perform. Tracked on issue #5480. The finding id is recorded for a human auditor: the readiness check reads a check name from GitHub's check rollup and never sees which finding produced it, so nothing enforces that a future failure under this check name is this same finding. The pull_requests and expires bounds are what limit the blast radius. PR #7330 triggers 7 findings of the same rule family, python.lang.security.audit.dangerous-subprocess-use-tainted-env-args (Semgrep comment 6812244985, 2026-11-12), at the subprocess.run call in the off-POSIX branch of lib/ptk_run.py, one per tree copy (src/claude, codex, copilot-cli, cursor, muse, and the two src/hermes packs). An independent security review classified all 7 as false positives: https://github.com/rjmurillo/ai-agents/pull/7330#issuecomment-6815658211. The call is list-form with no shell, the script path is validated against skills/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+.py with no part made of two or more dots, and the extra args reach the target the caller already runs with the same privileges. The owner approved this waiver on 2026-11-12 (D13, issue-sweep orchestrator thread) after that review. PR #7523 (owner decision D10, 2026-11-23): three cloud findings on the memory recall lib are not exploitable. Two are non-literal-import at frontmatter_reader.py:30, once in scripts/memory_enhancement and once in its src/claude/lib mirror; that call only receives the literals frontmatter and yaml. The third is the blocking finding below. The os.execv at src/claude/lib/memory_enhancement/interpreter.py:102 re-runs the hook's own argv under the project .venv and exists on main at line 99.

Verify dispatch closure against base.reason: PR #7523 adds one generated ADR-119 install link, .claude/lib/memory_enhancement, pointing at src/claude/lib/memory_enhancement, to ship per-prompt recall for issue #7493. verify_dispatch_closure.py examined 62 files at fc6a9a5b with 0 differing, 0 removed, and 0 unresolved loads; its only finding is that new symlink. _link_exemption.py exempts only the skills and skills-codex rows, so a lib link fails by design. The owner approved this waiver as decision D8 on 2026-11-23 for this PR only, instead of widening the exemption.

Renovate.reason: The Renovate job fails at its Verify BOT_PAT secret step because BOT_PAT is empty at run time, which no PR diff can change. A repo admin must set or rotate the secret. The owner approved this waiver on 2026-11-04 for these two PRs only, so any other Renovate PR still fails loudly until the secret is fixed.
